angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 840,733 km at 168.24 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.9441 +/- 0.0130 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 168.24 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.20847 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2227 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 840,733 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.025 (0.985 to 1.065) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5889.54 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2227 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2227 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2227.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.284, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2227 (pscomppars): [M/H] -0.0503 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2227 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.1619, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6385929006882225024, flags_flame 00: age_flame 6.34897 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 5.3860774 to 7.333064)
